caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a curved backrest and four splayed legs. The chair is primarily painted in a light beige or off-white color, with decorative blue horizontal lines on the legs, seat, and backrest. There are detailed floral motifs painted on the top rail, the central back rail, and the front edge of the seat; these motifs include yellow and orange flowers, green leaves, and some purple flowers clustered together, all outlined for emphasis. The four back spindles and one of the leg stretchers feature golden yellow accents. The entire chair is illustrated against a plain, light background with no additional objects present.
title: Pa. German Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
